why: Phase 1 (docs/PLAN.md D22) builds a real-jointed foreleg from this file. v1 only vendored the meshes and read this XML out of a downloaded wheel each time; vendoring it makes the body build reproducible without network access.

neuromechfly_seqik_kinorder_ypr.xml.modified: copied byte-for-byte out of the wheel, unmodified

note_mesh_scale: This MJCF references meshes with scale='1000 1000 1000': the STL files are in metres, the model is in millimetres.
note_tarsus_meshes: This MJCF references Tarsus2-5 meshes that are NOT vendored in mesh_neuromechfly/ (v1 only copied Tarsus1). Any builder reading this file must prune those bodies or vendor the missing STLs.
